action.description: plan checks the VM without changing anything. execute grants the access (or revokes it with revoke: true) and removes expired access to the VM.

vmId.description: Resource ID of the Linux VM.

principalId.description: Object ID of the Entra ID user who gets the access.

role.description: user logs in without sudo (Virtual Machine User Login), admin with sudo (Virtual Machine Administrator Login).

durationMinutes.description: How long the access lasts, at most the installation's limit. Granting again extends it and never shortens it.

revoke.description: Remove the user's access to the VM instead of granting it.
